answer_1.quote: We propose to improve semantic preservation in style transfer by modeling the task as a controlled paraphrase generation problem... Our unsupervised method (Style Transfer via Paraphrasing, or STRAP) requires no parallel data between different styles and proceeds in three simple stages... the system generates style‑transferred sentences.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate transfer accuracy (ACC) with a RoBERTa classifier, semantic similarity (SIM) with the sub‑word embedding‑based SIM model, and fluency (FL) with a RoBERTa classifier trained on CoLA; we also report the combined J(ACC,SIM,FL) score.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate SIM and FL using human evaluations. Annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk can choose one of three options: 0 for no paraphrase relationship; 1 for an ungrammatical paraphrase; and 2 for a grammatical paraphrase.
answer_4.guideline: Three‑point scale: 0 = no paraphrase, 1 = ungrammatical paraphrase, 2 = grammatical paraphrase.
